digest.component_or_area: metrics blame and bug close workflow
propositions: Clone guidance must document --filter=blob:none (1.04 GiB / 59 s vs 68.7 MiB / 14.3 s) and warn that --filter=tree:0 must never be used (3.57 GiB, 3.4x overhead).
_blame_file_commits currently returns [] both on git failure and on successful-but-empty result, making failure undetectable; it must distinguish by returning None on failure and [] on success-empty.

derive_caused_by loops over multiple paths and tallies blame results; partial blame failure (some paths succeed, others fail) causes a subset-based majority test that can elect an incorrect caused_by culprit.
derive_caused_by must abort and return None whenever _blame_file_commits returns None for any path, preventing incorrect caused_by links from partial-success scenarios.
A path with legitimately zero blamed lines must not abort the derivation or suppress the caused_by derivation.
Integration test must verify no caused_by link event is written when derive_caused_by returns None due to blame failure.
